paragraphs.text: Morven was one of the bodyguards of the wizard Towser . He lived on Aerona , part of the Domains of Dominaria .

Morven was a laconic man with bronzed skin and a face wrinkled as a crab's from squinting into wind and sun. A burly man, he had a gap-toothed grin, gray-white, curly hair, and a gray beard. He wore a faded blue shirt, white breeches, and sandals on crooked feet. He carried a crossbow. Across his life, he had thirteen wives in different seaports.

After thirty years as a sailor, Morven decided to retire and find a land job. He ended up hiring up as a bodyguard for the wizard Towser . After the Destruction of White Ridge , he was quick to befriend Gull when he joined their party, and helped him against the actions of the bully Kem .

Realizing the evil of Towser, he rebelled against him and was teleported to Towser's island with Gull. After being summoned back by Greensleeves , he helped the girl and her brother Gull in a decisive battle against Towser.

Morven, as a sailor, was the first to notice the sign of an approaching tsunami which had been cast by Greensleeves. He urged Gull, Greensleeves, Kem, and Stiggur to find refuge inside a crack in the cliffside. Realizing there wasn't enough space for him, he told Greensleeves to block the crack's entrance with a Wall of Wood and remained outside, sacrificing his life to the raging sea.
